items.title: How the Nvidia scandal impacts US–China relations: Department of Defense CTO
items.summary:
US Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick will reportedly testify before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 10 as lawmakers raise questions about how far Lutnick went to protect Nvidia's (NVDA) push to sell AI chips to China.

US Department of Defense (Department of War) CTO Emil Michael sits down with Deirdre Bosa to discuss the US–China relationship.
